items.summary:
Inter Miami’s new signing and Leo Messi’s new teammate, Casemiro, was asked in an interview who the better player is between Leo Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo, and here was his reply:

🗣️ “Well, it’s difficult for me to choose between the two because I played against Messi when I was at Madrid so many times, and I can say I managed to stop him a few times because he was almost unstoppable. As for Cristiano, he was my teammate at Madrid for about five or six years. I watched him train, and we played together. He was just a beast, and the goals he scored were simply unbelievable.

But even though Messi is my new teammate now and an unbelievable, magical player, I will go with Cristiano Ronaldo because he’s a complete player. He can score with his left foot, right foot, and his head. He can create chances too, so for me it’s Cristiano. And I do love Messi too hopefully we create magic together at inter Miami”.

I’ll never ever criticise him as a player, like he’s a bad footballer or things in that nature, I can never, show me anywhere I have, in fact, most things I criticise about him is his personality, beyond the football. That means, anyone who writes in favor of Ronaldo is not bias to you, but anyone who criticises him is biased, right? Very funny guy. I have just described YOUR bias. Again, it’s your problem, not mine. You’re not engaging a child who you can throw around for your pleasure. Ain’t on Twitter to please your bias.

Let’s talk about the video. Seedorf described the beginning of Ronaldo’s career. Ronaldo joined Man United at 18 and as at 2008, these were still the early parts of his career. I also mentioned 2008 because “2008” is the most referenced whenever the topic of Ronaldo is being talked about. You know this, I know this, everyone knows this.

His showboating, non-useful dribbles and exaggerated dance on the ball is common knowledge, except you want to lie to yourself. Plus, in my response to a tweet, I said I liked it, I love entertainment. Guess what, you ignored that part, why? It won’t be sweet? You won’t get more likes if you say that?

Okay Okay, that video was about wasting time? Do you need me to show you 10 other videos from pre-2008/2008 of showboating/exaggerated step overs/etc.? Do we want to pretend here?

items.title: 🇲🇦🗣 Walid Regragui on how they dealt with Cristiano Ronaldo's presence in the 2022 World  Cup match between Morocco and
items.summary:
🇲🇦🗣 Walid Regragui on how they dealt with Cristiano Ronaldo's presence in the 2022 World  Cup match between Morocco and Portugal:

"Ronaldo's introduction also changed the spirit of the game.

So we also had to manage the players emotionally.

It is true that it is Ronaldo, but we could not become too focused on playing against him.

Otherwise, we risk giving away free kicks or a penalty, and from a single action he can score.

Whenever Ronaldo had an opportunity, one player immediately went with him.

The objective was always to control the passing lanes.

One of the holding midfielders was always there to stop him from turning.

We also had to be alert to his movement.

Ronaldo moves exceptionally well.

He constantly attacks the space.

That is why we defended with three players.

If we had stayed with four at the back, Ronaldo would have found space very well, especially from crosses."  https://t.co/l5cUbYMkSX

items.title: Manchester United and Portugal star Bruno Fernandes in a recent interview about why Portugal got eliminated in the world
items.summary:
Manchester United and Portugal star Bruno Fernandes in a recent interview about why Portugal got eliminated in the world cup.

“We would have reached the World Cup final if not for Ronaldo. I’m going to say it clearly. He missed so many clear chances easy ones that he used to score with his eyes closed. Yet after the games he still complains that we don’t give him the ball enough. It’s the same story every time.
We try to play, we try to create, but everything has to go through him. The younger players stop their runs because they’re looking for him. The system becomes forced. When he doesn’t score, the mood in the dressing room drops. When he does score, everything is fine. That’s not how a team should work.
I have a lot of respect for what he has done in his career, but at this stage he is hurting the team more than helping it. If we had played without that constant pressure of feeding him, Portugal would have gone much further. I’m tired of pretending otherwise.”

items.title: Real Madrid and England star Jude Bellingham in a recent interview that is was asked if he felt any sympathy for Lionel
items.summary:
Real Madrid and England star Jude Bellingham in a recent interview that is was asked if he felt any sympathy for Lionel Messi after Argentina’s painful World Cup final defeat. 

“To be honest, I don’t feel sorry for him. It’s karma and he deserves the loss,” Bellingham said firmly. “I don’t see him as a legend. They cheat to win matches. Real legends like Ronaldo don’t cheat.”

Bellingham didn’t stop there. He went deeper into what he claims happened behind the scenes.

“They played rough and dirty back in the semi finals. Spence told me they were mocking him and calling him a donkey. They deserve the loss for the dishonesty. Messi and Argentina is the biggest fraud in football history.”

items.title: Cubarsi on who is the GOAT between Ronaldo and Messi.

Cubarsi on who is the GOAT between Ronaldo and Messi.

"This question puts me on the edge because I play for Fc Barcelona. But to be honest, when I was 3 or so back home in Spain every kid wanted to be like Cristiano Ronaldo.

But at La Masia we were warned to always choose Messi as the GOAT of football. 

Now i have the opportunity to play with both of them and I am happy about that. Cristiano treated me with respect but Messi's teammates injured me, instead of him to check up on me, he was asking the ref to send off Cucurella.

So I will tell you with all the truth in me that Ronaldo is the Greatest footballer in the whole world. Reason I wanted a shirt swap with him".

 🗣 "In my opinion, Argentina have often looked like an average team and, based on some of their performances, don't seem strong enough to be considered among the best World Cup sides. I also believe FIFA President Giovanni Vincenzo Infantino has shown favoritism toward Argentina and Lionel Messi, but that's simply very they are both gay friends 

🗣We watched the great Argentina teams of 1978 and 1986, so we know the standard they once set. In my opinion, some decisions during the 2026 World Cup were highly questionable, including what I believe was an offside in Messi's assist against England and another controversial moment against Egypt. Regardless, I was impressed by Spain's performance in the final they outplayed Argentina, who struggled to create clear chances and barely threatened from open play.

items.title: Real Madrid and England star Jude Bellingham in a recent interview that is was asked if he felt any sympathy for Lionel
items.summary:
Real Madrid and England star Jude Bellingham in a recent interview that is was asked if he felt any sympathy for Lionel Messi after Argentina’s painful World Cup final defeat. 

“To be honest, I don’t feel sorry for him. It’s karma and he deserves the loss,” Bellingham said firmly. “I don’t see him as a legend. They cheat to win matches. Real legends like Ronaldo don’t cheat.”

Bellingham didn’t stop there. He went deeper into what he claims happened behind the scenes.

“They played rough and dirty back in the semi finals. Spence told me they were mocking him and calling him a donkey. They deserve the loss for the dishonesty. Messi and Argentina is the biggest fraud in football history.”

items.title: Cubarsi on who is the GOAT between Ronaldo and Messi.
items.summary:
Cubarsi on who is the GOAT between Ronaldo and Messi.

"This question puts me on the edge because I play for Fc Barcelona. But to be honest, when I was 3 or so back home in Spain every kid wanted to be like Cristiano Ronaldo.

But at La Masia we were warned to always choose Messi as the GOAT of football. 

Now i have the opportunity to play with both of them and I am happy about that. Cristiano treated me with respect but Messi's teammates injured me, instead of him to check up on me, he was asking the ref to send off Cucurella.

So I will tell you with all the truth in me that Ronaldo is the Greatest footballer in the whole world. Reason I wanted a shirt swap with him".

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s wife, Georgina Rodríguez, reportedly spoke about Argentina and alleged corruption during the World C
items.summary:
Cristiano Ronaldo’s wife, Georgina Rodríguez, reportedly spoke about Argentina and alleged corruption during the World Cup:

“Even though I was born in Argentina, I can never fully accept them as my country because of the way they treated Cristiano. The constant criticism and attacks affected his mental health during the World Cup. Thankfully, they were eventually defeated by Spain in the final because, in my opinion, they have always had unfair advantages. I also believe FIFA’s president has supported them for a long time, but I’m happy they lost, and even Cristiano was pleased with the outcome.”
